newsitem.title: UK: BA says cabin crew endorse efficiency plans. [CORRECTED 9:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BA says cabin crew endorse efficiency plans. [CORRECTED 9:22 GMT]

text.p: British Airways said on Friday its cabin crew union Cabin Crew 89 had overwhelmingly voted in favour of proposals that endorsed the airlines' efficiency plans.
The plans covered pay restructuring that would provide crew with higher pensionable pay, in return for efficiencies within the department and lower pay rates for new crew staff.
A total of 78 percent of cabin staff who replied to the postal ballot had agreed to accept the deal, BA said. About 77 percent members had turned out to vote on the plan, which closed on Thursday.

BA's announcement came a day after its World Cargo staff had voted in favour of plans to convert it into a world class freight carrier, which included a two-year pay freeze and loss of 400 jobs from the current work force over the next two years.
British Airways said both deals would contribute towards its plans to generate one billion stg of cost savings by 2000.
